items.stem: A company issues new shares in an IPO and investors later trade those shares on an exchange. The company receives cash:

options.rationale: Correct: the issuer is paid at primary issuance, not on later trades.

options.text: Every time the share changes hands
options.rationale: Secondary trades are between investors; the company is not paid.
Price moves do not pay the company.
Dividends flow from the company to holders, not the reverse.
